purpose: Calculates the coherency strain strengthening increment Δσ_cs, one contribution to the total precipitation strengthening under the dislocation shearing mechanism in Fe-Mn-Al-C alloys.
applicability_conditions: Applies to the dislocation shearing regime of precipitate strengthening; in the present work, intragranular κ-carbides in the 550-6 and 650-6 samples (average sizes ~11 nm and ~24 nm, respectively) remain in the shearing regime.
unmapped: The provided context does not include an explicit 'where' clause for Eq. (2); the symbol meanings follow standard precipitation-strengthening terminology.
Intragranular κ-carbides in the 550-6 and 650-6 samples have average sizes of ~11 nm and ~24 nm, respectively, and remain in the shearing regime (Fig. 13a,b).
A critical precipitate size of approximately 27 nm for the transition from shearing to Orowan bypassing was reported in analogous alloy systems.
